requires: Rungs have no "save": they play mopic_demo1's own progress (app.sav). Today's run-ladder.ps1 refuses that ('rung <name> has no save'); it needs the save-less rung change. Without it, pin each rung to the baseline: "save": "runs\\save-sets\\sonicdemo\\own\\20261002-baseline\\76561199750818073\\app.sav" (SonicDemo-gp.json has a save_slot for app.sav).
notes: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Demo build 21761499 (appid 3601140; updated 2026-09-30, auto-update on). Saves in %APPDATA%\SEGA\SonicRacingCrossWorldsDemo\steam\76561199750818073 (encrypted), Steam Cloud on for app/net/playlog.sav; demo progress carries over to the full game. Baseline copy: runs\save-sets\sonicdemo\own\20261002-baseline.

Playable demo content: Grand Prix cup 1 only (E-스타디움 > 레인보우 가든 > 워터 팰리스; lap 2 goes through a CrossWorld picked at the Travel Ring by the leader, so repeated cups show different ones of the 5), characters SONIC, TAILS, KNUCKLES, AMY, classes Normal / High / Sonic Speed (Super Sonic and Mirror locked), 15 machines incl. Extreme Gear, Time Trial (does not start in the recipes so far), Garage menus. Race Park and Online are locked.

Keyboard: Space accelerate (not W: W is the forward item throw), A/D steer, E or LShift drift, Q item, T gadget, C brake/back, F rear view (F on the hub = Steam store), Tab/Esc pause. UEVR does not take the keyboard away: its XInput hook reports a pad only after a VR motion controller was used (VR::on_xinput_get_state, is_using_controllers_within), which never happens on the Mopic display, and the menus show keyboard glyphs under UEVR.

Tiers: 1 = the whole cup with each of the 4 characters (High Speed, default machine), about 13-15 min each; 2 = the other two classes (run in this order: Sonic Speed then Normal, because the class cursor may be remembered); 3 = an Extreme Gear machine (vehicle select layout TODO).

Race end and cup end: a race ends when the next 'ROUND n' banner shows; the cup's end screen (gp_result) is not recorded yet, so every rung stops there (MENU_FAIL after the third race was played) until it is.
